source.quote: Personality and prior behavior patterns of coping with stress, previous work roles, and a need to search for secure people or places are also associated with wandering.2 Observable emotional expression can be related with wandering.35 Positive emotional expression was positively related to wandering rates, whereas negative emotional expression and higher cognitive status were negatively related to wandering rates.35 These results suggest that persons with dementia who are prone to express negative feelings such as sad or angry feelings may sit alone or stay in their rooms for longer periods, rather than walk around.

source.quote: 또한, 치매의 정도가 심각하거나, 인 성의약품은 근육 강직이나 떨림 등과 같은 추체외로 부작용 지기능 점수가 낮을수록, 공격성, 우울, 망상 등과 같은 여러 (Extrapyramidal Symptoms, EPS) 및 공격적인 행동 또 다 가지 행동심리증상이 동반되었을 때 배회 행동의 빈도가 증 른 치매의 정신적 문제행동을 유발할 수 있다[21-23].
